engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control interfaces for direction lights, specifying how different instances (InstanceID) can be used to turn on or off right rear and left front turning lights via various controllers and control methods. It is used for testing the correct implementation and behavior of these interfaces in the vehicle's electronic system.
